question: Count completed purchases in each customer region
oracle_sql: SELECT c.region,COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY c.region

question: How many distinct product categories have sold at least one item on completed orders?
oracle_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id=p.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=oi.order_id WHERE o.status='completed'

question: Average gross revenue per completed order
oracle_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(revenue),2) FROM (SELECT o.order_id,SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id=oi.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY o.order_id)

question: Which product has the highest completed order revenue? Return product_id and rounded revenue.
oracle_sql: SELECT oi.product_id,ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price),2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY oi.product_id ORDER BY revenue DESC,oi.product_id LIMIT 1

question: For each month, sum revenue of completed orders
oracle_sql: SELECT substr(o.order_date,1,7),ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price),2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id=oi.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY substr(o.order_date,1,7)

question: Count small-business customers per region
oracle_sql: SELECT region,COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE segment='small_business' GROUP BY region

question: Count agents with no tickets
oracle_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agents a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tickets t WHERE t.agent_id=a.agent_id)

question: Average work minutes per resolved ticket
oracle_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_minutes),2) FROM (SELECT t.ticket_id,SUM(w.minutes) AS total_minutes FROM tickets t JOIN worklogs w ON t.ticket_id=w.ticket_id WHERE t.state='resolved' GROUP BY t.ticket_id)

question: Number of resolved tickets per team in Mexico
oracle_sql: SELECT a.team,COUNT(*) FROM tickets t JOIN agents a ON t.agent_id=a.agent_id WHERE t.state='resolved' AND a.location='mx' GROUP BY a.team

question: Distinct agents assigned high-priority tickets
oracle_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT agent_id) FROM tickets WHERE priority='high'
